svg.text: USB — powers the board + uploads firmware
(does NOT power the motor or servo)
(≥ 1 A — now feeding the ULN2003 AND the SG90,
SG90 + Limit Switch + 0.96" OLED → ESP8266 (NodeMCU) → ULN2003 Driver → 28BYJ-48 Stepper
Trips once per turn at nail 0
Nail at the feeder, next nail,
Wiring reference (must match the firmware’s pin definitions):
ESP8266 D3 (GPIO0) → SG90 feeder servo signal
ESP8266 D0 (GPIO16) ← Limit switch LEG A (+ 10k pull-up to 3V3)
ESP8266 3V3 → OLED VCC (3.3 V — never 5 V)
ESP8266 D4 (GPIO2) → OLED SCL (may be labelled SCK)
D1/D2 (the usual I2C pair) drive the stepper, so the OLED uses D7 (SDA) + D4 (SCL) — and the limit switch moved from D7 to D0. D8 is left free: it must be LOW at boot.
D3 and D4 must be HIGH at reset — the servo input and the OLED's pull-up keep them HIGH. D0 has no internal pull-up, hence the 10k to 3V3.
